analysis.headline: Supreme Court Strikes Down Trump Birthright Citizenship Executive Order

outlook: Watch whether Republicans pursue a constitutional amendment to restrict birthright citizenship, and whether they can secure the two-thirds congressional majorities required.

categories: politics, world cup, hide from hp

analysis.summary: Bosnian refugees have revitalized the economically struggling city of Utica in the Rust Belt region.
